purpose: One provisional representative facility per Japan golf travel cluster for regional climate assessment. This registry is backend-only and does not activate or modify existing weather points.
selectionRules: One representative location per practical golf cluster; other facilities in the same cluster share regional climate assessment.
A representative selection is provisional until identity, current operation, address, coordinate and cluster assignment are validated.
Do not enable weather points from this file; weatherEnabled remains false until a separate acceptance step.
A multi-layout facility remains one facility record unless layouts are independently selectable in the app.
sourceNotes: JNTO official Japan golf directory is a curated selection, not a complete national facility census.
Official operator pages are preferred for facility identity and address; third-party directories remain discovery evidence only.
Seasonal Hokkaido operating dates must be reconfirmed for each travel year.
